From a64917446eafc7212e962561622d697fce04e9a6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Aviv Heller <avivh@mellanox.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Dec 2018 19:03:27 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] net/mlx5: Fix LAG requirement when CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH is off

If CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH is not defined, test for SR-IOV being disabled,
instead of calling e-switch LAG prereq routine.

Since LAG with SRIOV is allowed only when switchdev mode is on.

Fixes: eff849b2c669 ("net/mlx5: Allow/disallow LAG according to pre-req only")
Signed-off-by: Aviv Heller <avivh@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: Saeed Mahameed <saeedm@mellanox.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/lag.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/lag.c
index 5187dc7a72a3..3a6baed722d8 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/lag.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/lag.c
@@ -291,12 +291,15 @@ static int mlx5_deactivate_lag(struct mlx5_lag *ldev)
 
 static bool mlx5_lag_check_prereq(struct mlx5_lag *ldev)
 {
-	if (ldev->pf[0].dev &&
-	    ldev->pf[1].dev &&
-	    mlx5_esw_lag_prereq(ldev->pf[0].dev, ldev->pf[1].dev))
-		return true;
-	else
+	if (!ldev->pf[0].dev || !ldev->pf[1].dev)
 		return false;
+
+#ifdef CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH
+	return mlx5_esw_lag_prereq(ldev->pf[0].dev, ldev->pf[1].dev);
+#else
+	return (!mlx5_sriov_is_enabled(ldev->pf[0].dev) &&
+		!mlx5_sriov_is_enabled(ldev->pf[1].dev));
+#endif
 }
 
 static void mlx5_lag_add_ib_devices(struct mlx5_lag *ldev)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/lag.c`**
- The function `mlx5_lag_check_prereq` has been modified to change the logic for checking prerequisites for Link Aggregation Group (LAG).
- The original check for LAG prerequisites using `mlx5_esw_lag_prereq` is now conditional based on whether `CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH` is defined.
- If `CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH` is not defined, the function now checks if SR-IOV is disabled for both devices instead of calling the e-switch LAG prerequisite routine.
- The return value logic has been adjusted to ensure that LAG is only allowed when SR-IOV is not enabled if the e-switch mode is off.

### Relationships Between Modifications
- The changes in `lag.c` are directly related to the configuration option `CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH`. The modification ensures that the LAG prerequisites are correctly evaluated based on the presence or absence of this configuration.
- The fix addresses a specific bug where LAG was incorrectly allowed or disallowed based on the e-switch prerequisites when it should have been based on the SR-IOV status instead, thus improving the overall correctness of the LAG functionality in the driver.

Here is the commit message:
net/mlx5: Fix LAG requirement when CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH is off

If CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH is not defined, test for SR-IOV being disabled,
instead of calling e-switch LAG prereq routine.

Since LAG with SRIOV is allowed only when switchdev mode is on.

Fixes: eff849b2c669 ("net/mlx5: Allow/disallow LAG according to pre-req only")
Signed-off-by: Aviv Heller <avivh@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: Saeed Mahameed <saeedm@mellanox.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect evaluation of prerequisites for Link Aggregation Group (LAG) when the `CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH` configuration option was not defined. The code was still calling the e-switch LAG prerequisite routine, which is only valid when switchdev mode is enabled. This led to situations where LAG could be incorrectly allowed or disallowed based on the e-switch prerequisites instead of the actual SR-IOV status of the devices.

Here is the patch:
 
 static bool mlx5_lag_check_prereq(struct mlx5_lag *ldev)
 {
-	if (ldev->pf[0].dev &&
-	    ldev->pf[1].dev &&
-	    mlx5_esw_lag_prereq(ldev->pf[0].dev, ldev->pf[1].dev))
-		return true;
-	else
+	if (!ldev->pf[0].dev || !ldev->pf[1].dev)
 		return false;
+
+#ifdef CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH
+	return mlx5_esw_lag_prereq(ldev->pf[0].dev, ldev->pf[1].dev);
+#else
+	return (!mlx5_sriov_is_enabled(ldev->pf[0].dev) &&
+		!mlx5_sriov_is_enabled(ldev->pf[1].dev));
+#endif
 }

```c

```
```c

```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the code incorrectly calls the `mlx5_esw_lag_prereq` function to evaluate LAG prerequisites even when `CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH` is not defined. This leads to incorrect evaluations of whether LAG should be allowed or disallowed, as the e-switch prerequisites are only valid in switchdev mode. Thus, the check does not consider the actual SR-IOV status of the devices.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
#ifdef CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH
return mlx5_esw_lag_prereq(ldev->pf[0].dev, ldev->pf[1].dev);
#else
return (!mlx5_sriov_is_enabled(ldev->pf[0].dev) &&
	!mlx5_sriov_is_enabled(ldev->pf[1].dev));
#endif
```
Reason:
The fix introduces a conditional compilation block that checks if `CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH` is defined. If it is not defined, the code now correctly evaluates the SR-IOV status of the devices instead of calling the e-switch prerequisite function. This ensures that LAG is only allowed when SR-IOV is disabled, aligning the behavior with the intended requirements.
